name: carousel-29
description: Team directory cards with avatar initials, status badges, and contact buttons.

files.content:
import { MailIcon, MessageSquareIcon } from "lucide-react" import { Avatar, AvatarFallback } from "@workspace/ui/components/avatar" import { Badge } from "@workspace/ui/components/badge" import { Button } from "@workspace/ui/components/button" import { Card, CardContent } from "@workspace/ui/components/card" import { Carousel, CarouselContent, CarouselItem, CarouselNext, CarouselPrevious, } from "@workspace/ui/components/carousel" const people = [ { name: "Hana Ito", role: "Product Designer", status: "Online" }, { name: "Marco Bell", role: "Staff Engineer", status: "In a meeting" }, { name: "Priya Shah", role: "Data Analyst", status: "Online" }, { name: "Jon Weller", role: "Support Lead", status: "Away" }, { name: "Sofia Lund", role: "Recruiter", status: "Online" }, ] export default function TeamDirectoryCarousel() { return ( {people.map((person) => ( {person.name .split(" ") .map((p) => p[0]) .join("")}

{person.name}

{person.role}

{person.status}
))} ) }
